identity.name: NexoraSIM
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Telecom utility with Cybersecurity aesthetics.
Emotion First: Evoke trust and control.
Content is King: Data density with clarity.
Zoom In: Focus on critical status indicators.
Negative Space: Use to separate dense data clusters.
Contrast: High contrast for readability in dark mode.

cards.style: Flat, 1px border (border-border), no shadow in dark mode

inputs.style: bg-background border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent rounded-md

tables.style: Dense, high contrast headers, row hover effects

steps: 1. Install dependencies: `npm install framer-motion lucide-react recharts clsx tailwind-merge`
2. Configure Tailwind: Update `tailwind.config.js` with the defined colors and fonts.
3. Setup Fonts: Add Chivo and IBM Plex Sans to `layout.js` or `globals.css`.
4. Create Layout: Implement the Sidebar and Header layout.
5. Build Components: Create reusable components (Cards, Tables, Stats) using the design system.
6. Implement Pages: Build Dashboard, Profiles, Devices, etc., using the Bento Grid layout.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures or noise overlays can separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
